card.title: For Stability’s Sake
card.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave the director's name on the launch programme. The department heads need someone above them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Her resignation is in the printer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put it in my drawer. Without her, they'll each claim the launch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking which of them gets her opening speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll read it on her behalf. Give them equal introductions; nobody inherits the microphone.

mechanism: A conceals a director's resignation to keep department heads from contesting leadership of the launch.
confusable: Unlike protecting a person from embarrassment, A must preserve the existing power balance through the concealed truth.
comparison: D63-a distributes equal introductions under the absent director's name; D63-b delays a debt signature to preserve a chair's public authority.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
